classification.reason: REBOUND 4.6.0 directly rejects nonstandard WHFast kernels with native variations; recovered historical settings are internally consistent and supported.

historical_scope.manifest_18_scope: historical combined standard-kernel WHFast physical+tangent/MEGNO configuration only

literature_review.paraphrase: Splitting nearly Keplerian planetary motion enables efficient long-term symplectic maps.
literature_review.scope_caveat: Does not specify REBOUND implementation settings.
literature_review.title: Symplectic maps for the n-body problem

literature_review.paraphrase: Stable Jacobi transforms remove secular implementation bias; correctors and a symplectic tangent map support LCN and MEGNO.
literature_review.scope_caveat: Does not imply support for later nonstandard kernels with variations.
literature_review.title: WHFast: a fast and unbiased implementation of a symplectic Wisdom-Holman integrator for long-term gravitational simulations

literature_review.authors: Rein, H.; Tamayo, D.; Brown, G.
literature_review.direct_applicability: Directly explains the physical-WHCKL versus native-tangent capability split.
literature_review.paraphrase: High-order kernels and correctors can greatly reduce physical integration error, but the implemented kernels do not support variational equations or MEGNO.
literature_review.scope_caveat: Accuracy gains are problem- and timestep-dependent and do not establish causation here.
literature_review.software_version_or_commit: REBOUND high-order kernel implementation; checked against 4.6.0 source
literature_review.title: High-order symplectic integrators for planetary dynamics and their implementation in REBOUND

literature_review.direct_applicability: Supports the analytic first-variation telemetry requirement.
literature_review.paraphrase: Variational equations provide derivatives and chaos indicators without finite differencing.
literature_review.scope_caveat: The paper's second-order examples emphasize IAS15; exact WHFast constraints come from tagged source.
literature_review.title: Second-order variational equations for N-body simulations

literature_review.authors: Cincotta, P. M.; Giordano, C. M.; Simo, C.
literature_review.paraphrase: MEGNO integrates first variations and can estimate hyperbolicity and the Lyapunov characteristic number.
literature_review.scope_caveat: Does not prescribe REBOUND synchronization or kernel settings.
literature_review.title: Phase space structure of multi-dimensional systems by means of the mean exponential growth factor of nearby orbits

literature_review.authors: Tamayo, D.; Rein, H.; Shi, P.; Hernandez, D. M.
literature_review.direct_applicability: The validated gr_potential callback is position-only.
literature_review.paraphrase: Position-dependent conservative effects can remain compatible with symplectic splitting; velocity-dependent post-Newtonian approximations require special care.
literature_review.scope_caveat: The project uses a custom analytic tangent callback, not the stock effect object.
literature_review.title: REBOUNDx: a library for adding conservative and dissipative forces to otherwise symplectic N-body integrations

literature_review.direct_applicability: Demonstrates a precedent for a separate canonical physical lane.
literature_review.paraphrase: WHCKL has been used for large ensembles of long-term physical Solar-System trajectories.
literature_review.scope_caveat: Its model, timestep, and scientific target differ from M0.
literature_review.title: A repository of vanilla long-term integrations of the Solar System

literature_review.authors: Hernandez, D. M.; Zeebe, R. E.; Hadden, S.
literature_review.direct_applicability: Motivates successor screening with orbital and secular observables, not energy alone.
literature_review.paraphrase: Pointwise and statistical reliability can depend on resolving Mercury's perihelion passage; energy error alone is not decisive.
literature_review.scope_caveat: Does not diagnose the completed M0 lanes by inspection.
literature_review.title: Stepsize errors in the N-body problem: discerning Mercury's true possible long-term orbits

literature_review.authors: Rein, H.; Brown, G.; Kanda, M.
literature_review.direct_applicability: Limits the interpretation of the one-trajectory Step 3 pointwise failures.
literature_review.paraphrase: Long-term chaotic Solar-System integrations can converge statistically even when individual trajectories diverge pointwise.
literature_review.scope_caveat: Does not waive M0's preregistered production gates.
literature_review.title: On the statistical convergence of N-body simulations of the Solar System

literature_review.direct_applicability: Supports separating pointwise reproducibility from ensemble claims.
literature_review.paraphrase: A single chaotic instability time is one draw from a distribution of nearby valid trajectories.
literature_review.scope_caveat: Compact-system distributions are not a direct M0 threshold calibration.
literature_review.title: Fundamental limits from chaos on instability time predictions in compact planetary systems

operational_conclusions.canonical_physical_lane: Eligible for a nonstandard WHCKL/lazy kernel only without native variations in REBOUND 4.6.0.
operational_conclusions.historical_combined_lane: Supported standard-kernel Jacobi first-variation configuration; no material mismatch found.
operational_conclusions.split_lane_necessity: Required only to combine a nonstandard canonical physical kernel with native tangent/MEGNO diagnostics.
operational_conclusions.synchronization_causation: Not established; existing physical-only controls do not support synchronization as the sole mechanism.
operational_conclusions.tangent_megno_lane: Requires the standard kernel and Jacobi coordinates; correctors and safe_mode=0/keep_unsynchronized=1 remain feasible.
operational_conclusions.two_day_output_caveat: The historical 2-day lane used shortened one-day endpoint steps at 100-year outputs; decisive 0.5/0.25/0.125-day lanes divide the cadence exactly.

source_findings.finding: The Python accessors read current C state or particle arrays and do not call the WHFast synchronization routine.
source_findings.historical_applicability: Historical scientific samples are nevertheless synchronized because the runner calls integrate for every target and REBOUND synchronizes before integrate returns.

source_findings.finding: The WHCKL shortcut selects WHFast with the lazy kernel and first symplectic corrector order 17.
source_findings.historical_applicability: This is a concrete candidate for a future physical-only lane; it cannot be selected in a native variation/MEGNO lane because the nonstandard kernel is rejected.

source_findings.finding: Defaults are Jacobi coordinates, standard kernel, no correctors, safe_mode=1, keep_unsynchronized=0, synchronized state, and no forced coordinate recalculation.
source_findings.historical_applicability: Matches the three combined-lane archives and Manifest 13 current-sync controls.

source_findings.finding: WHFast first variations require Jacobi coordinates and the standard kernel; nonstandard kernels are rejected rather than silently downgraded.
source_findings.historical_applicability: A native tangent/MEGNO lane cannot select WHCKL or another nonstandard kernel in REBOUND 4.6.0.

source_findings.finding: Corrector orders 3, 5, 7, 11, and 17 are accepted in Jacobi or barycentric coordinates, and Jacobi variation blocks are transformed during synchronization.
source_findings.historical_applicability: Correctors remain technically feasible for the standard-kernel combined lane, although none was requested historically.

source_findings.finding: With variations, WHFast constructs synchronized inertial x/v/a every timestep for MEGNO. keep_unsynchronized=1 preserves and restores the internal map around that calculation.
source_findings.historical_applicability: Historical combined lanes used safe_mode=1, so they already synchronized each step before the MEGNO-specific path.

source_findings.finding: safe_mode=1 and keep_unsynchronized=1 are incompatible. safe_mode=1 recalculates map coordinates and synchronizes every step; safe_mode=0 with keep_unsynchronized=1 retains the internal map.
source_findings.historical_applicability: Manifest 15 tested both current-sync and minimal-sync physical-only controls; minimal synchronization did not supply a material causal improvement.

source_findings.finding: exact_finish_time=1 shortens a final step only when needed, restores dt afterward, and integrate synchronizes before returning.
source_findings.historical_applicability: The 0.5, 0.25, and 0.125 day lanes divide the 100-year output cadence exactly; the older 2-day lane did not and received a one-day shortened endpoint step at each output.

source_findings.finding: Archives serialize particles, variations, MEGNO state, WHFast map state, p_jh, kernel, coordinates, correctors, and synchronization flags without first forcing synchronization.
source_findings.historical_applicability: Existing archive hashes remained unchanged during direct restoration and their effective settings match the manifests.

source_findings.finding: Function pointers are flagged but not serialized and must be reset after restore.
source_findings.historical_applicability: The production resume path explicitly reattaches the validated compiled callback after archive validation.

source_findings.finding: gr_potential is position-only, preserves WHFast splitting, reproduces perihelion precession, has a documented mean-motion error of order GM/(a c^2), and uses the validated -3 G^2 M^2 m/(c^2 r^2) potential.
source_findings.historical_applicability: The custom callback implements the same physical acceleration and potential plus its analytic first-variation Jacobian and central response.

successor_recommendation.architecture: separate canonical physical WHCKL (lazy kernel, corrector 17) and standard-kernel tangent/MEGNO (corrector 17) lanes
successor_recommendation.smallest_screen: two fresh preregistered 10-kyr lanes at 0.25 day and 100-year output cadence, compared with the qualified IAS15 10-kyr envelope

zero_step_probe.note: rand_seed is advanced by initialization; the requested seed is preserved separately.
